title: Kalbhairav
brief_description: Stone sculpture of Kalbhairav, a fierce manifestation of Lord Shiva, acquired from Vargini in Sanguem Taluka, Goa.
detailed_description: This sculpture depicts Kalbhairav, one of the most powerful and fierce manifestations of Lord Shiva, revered as the guardian of sacred places and the protector of dharma. The deity is portrayed standing beneath an ornate architectural arch and adorned with elaborate ornaments and a decorated crown. The sculpture exhibits the refined stone-carving traditions of the Kadamba period and reflects the artistic excellence of medieval Goan temple sculpture. Acquired from Vargini in Sanguem Taluka, Goa, this 13th Century C.E. artifact represents the religious devotion and iconographic traditions associated with Shaivism. Kalbhairav is regarded as the divine guardian who destroys evil, protects devotees, and symbolizes justice, courage, and spiritual power.
